definition.def: An apparent situation, quality, or feeling seems to exist, although you cannot be certain that it does exist.
examples: I was a bit depressed by our apparent lack of progress.
There is at last an apparent end to the destructive price war.

definition.def: If something is apparent to you, it is clear and obvious to you.
examples: It has been apparent that in other areas standards have held up well.
The presence of a star is already apparent in the early film.

definition.def: If you say that something happens for no apparent reason, you cannot understand why it happens.
examples: The person may become dizzy for no apparent reason.
